# Synthetic PRD excerpt for evidence-verifier fixtures

This is a synthetic copy of the planning PRD's §13 gate table. It exists only to exercise `scripts/verify_evidence.py`; it is not product evidence and makes no claim that any gate ran.

## 13. Acceptance gates: literal commands and binary assertions

Tests and support scripts named below are required deliverables, not assertions that these files already exist. All commands run from the feature checkout using its activated local environment. The suite fixture must sanitize HOME/XDG/host-specific configuration variables and block non-loopback sockets in parent and spawned Python processes. `ARTIFACTS` denotes the authorized external evidence directory. Assertions are conjunctive: every assertion in a gate must pass. Subtests/parametrized cases must identify which required behavior failed. No acceptance gate may skip itself because a credential, Node, or package artifact is unavailable; provision prerequisites or report the gate unmet.

### Evidence and delivery bootstrap rules

Provide `scripts/verify_evidence.py` as a local/offline verifier of a JSON evidence manifest, not a self-awarding test runner. For AC-01–42 store command, exit code, log path, test summary, and tested source tree. Review and deeper-QA reports must list concrete cases/findings, not just “approved.” Tests for the delivery contract read evidence via an explicit `DEEPSEARCH_AXI_EVIDENCE_DIR`; never inspect arbitrary operator directories. CI runs AC-45's repository/process validation with a synthetic valid/invalid evidence fixture; final local acceptance runs it with the real evidence directory.

After implementation checks/reviews, commit intended feature files. Record AC-44 and real-evidence AC-45. The handoff/evidence manifest is external and can now record that final commit. Run AC-43 last: it validates the other records and computes its own current verification result without requiring an already successful AC-43 record. Store that result after successful completion and re-run in read-only confirmation mode. Documentation-only evidence amendments do not require product commits. Any source correction after review invalidates affected test records, requires reruns/re-review of the correction, and changes the tested-commit identifier. Never report a planning command, mocked HTTP-only unit test, or unrun future test as completed product validation.

Handoff artifact must name feature branch, full final commit, initial base, changed tracked files, each validation result and evidence path, independent review/QA synthesis, any unmet requirements, and explicitly “no live API calls performed; managing crewmate acceptance pending.” The feature commit is the deliverable; this worker must not integrate or publish it.
